AI-based summarization is identified as an automation opportunity for extraction, but it is not the current method — the process is currently manual."}, {"question_id": "Q3", "question": "How is the list of email recipients determined — is it automatically taken from the meeting invite, maintained as a standing distribution list, or chosen manually each time by the sender?", "answer": "The workflow references a participant list as an input and the minute taker sends the email to relevant recipients, but the exact method for determining the recipient list is not specified.
